claim: In the matching retail DLL, the Menu_SoundManager initialization spine is closed across seven exact methods: Menu_SoundManager..ctor (0x0600527B), set__instance (0x0600527D), Awake (0x0600527E), Start (0x0600527F), Initalize_State (0x06005280), AudioClipInfo..ctor (0x060052C1), and AudioSrcInfo..ctor (0x060052C3). The Menu_SoundManager constructor is a 7-byte MonoBehaviour base-constructor leaf; set__instance is a 7-byte static writer of field inst (0x040086EA); Start is a 1-byte ret. Awake is an exact 66-byte body: when static audioClipInfo (0x040086F4) is null it allocates AudioClipInfo[39], fills all raw indices 0..38 with new AudioClipInfo instances, then in all cases writes Sound_ClipMatchSE_List_Load_End (0x040086FC)=false and directly calls Initalize_State. Initalize_State is an exact 236-byte body. When canonical FACT-0112 get__instance() compares equal to null, it finds exact GameObject string 'Sound_Manager', adds AudioListener through MethodSpec 0x2B00004A, allocates AudioSrcInfo[8], fills raw indices 0..7 with new AudioSrcInfo, then for raw indices 0..7 adds AudioSource through MethodSpec 0x2B00004C and stores each into AudioSrcInfo.sRefAudio (0x0400874C); it writes audio_source_index (0x040086F5)=0; gets Menu_SoundManager from the GameObject through MethodSpec 0x2B0003E1 and calls set__instance; calls UnityEngine.Object.DontDestroyOnLoad; allocates Single[39] into lockTimes (0x040086ED); then directly calls still-open Resume_State (0x06005281) and Load_SystemSe (0x06005283). After that shared path, it reads the active Scene name. If the name equals exact string 'Match' or exact string 'main', it passes exact string 'Load_MatchSe' to external Unity MonoBehaviour.StartCoroutine(String); otherwise it directly calls Load_SystemSe. The AudioClipInfo and AudioSrcInfo constructors are byte-identical 7-byte System.Object base-constructor leaves. No Unity lifecycle caller edge to Menu_SoundManager Awake/Start is promoted, and the StartCoroutine('Load_MatchSe') name match is not promoted into a direct MethodDef edge.
